rules.sentence: The syndrome of delirium presents for hours to days.
Results from a recent study estimated that delirium is unrecognized in up to 60% of cases.
Hyperactive delirium is much easier to detect because patients are often agitated.
However, hypoactive delirium is usually missed, as patients are more withdrawn.

Caregivers may provide clues to the presence of hypoactive delirium with comments such as "They are sleeping more than usual," "They haven't eaten much in the last few days," or "I am worried they are depressed; they just stay in their room all day."
